game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Crevasse Bridge, a rope bridge over a crevasse: the mountaineer must hold off frost wyrms while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Palindrome Gate: Check whether a word reads the same backward to open the gate.
theme: Frost Peaks – Crevasse Bridge: a rope bridge over a crevasse
core_gameplay_loop: In Crevasse Bridge, repeat each round: Check whether a word reads the same backward to open the gate. Then check gate and advance.
player_objective: Protect the rescue sled from frost wyrms in Crevasse Bridge: keep gate above zero until the 34-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 5 (applied tier): Palindrome Gate
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 8, Level 5, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

region.name: Frost Peaks

tutorial.message: Frost wyrms are coming! Watch the gate meter.
Press SPACE to run a code fix when the meter drops.
Look at the code: word == word[::-1]
Survive for 34 seconds to complete the level.
